verdict.rationale: NVIDIA positions this as a desktop/workstation GPU explicitly as an alternative to datacenter resources (docs-10), not as a datacenter-scale part; there is no documentation of NVLink, Infinity Fabric, or rack-scale multi-GPU interconnect for this SKU. Community discussion further notes these cards run over standard PCIe in workstation chassis (comm-1, comm-4) and lack the SM100/tcgen05 features found in true datacenter Blackwell parts (comm-4), reinforcing that it is not built for datacenter-scale deployment.
